Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui.appearance

package dev.turboism.sdk.ui.appearance
Bounded, preview appearance overlays for selected semantic native controls.

Plugins submit immutable colors, fonts, and closed target types rather than Swing objects, UI defaults, raw resource paths, selectors, or host class names. Runtime policy owns arbitration, baseline capture, apply/refresh, restoration, exact-version provider admission, and plugin-generation cleanup. Permission to register an overlay does not prove native host appearance support or real-host readiness.
